schema.title: Standardized Trigger Contract
schema.description: Self-contained HTTP trigger schema. Includes the standard shared trigger fields and the flow-specific field.

id.description: Primary identifier associated with the request.

device.description: Device information related to the request.

schema.x-compatibility-note: Shared and flow-specific trigger fields are fully built into this single schema without external references.
